decisions.reasoning: Reject six incorrect Tris-base resolver aliases. Seven assigned reagent occurrences support separate crystalline Tris hydrochloride salt; six stock occurrences specify1M,pH7.5; two specify0.5M,pH8.0. TOGO M2313 states50mM,pH7.8 in the finalminimalmedium and does not define a separately prepared50mMstock. No blanketTris-HCl alias maps all16occurrences. NEW-03 withdraws the inferred Tris-moiety and chloride-species material partonomy from both buffer candidates. The source-defined 1 M pH 7.5 and 0.5 M pH 8.0 specifications remain positive whole-preparation differences; no solvent, HCl input or neutralization ratio is inferred.
decisions.applicability: The sixteen occurrences comprise seven weighed reagent contexts supporting Tris hydrochloride salt, six stock contexts specifying 1 M at pH 7.5, two stock contexts specifying 0.5 M at pH 8.0, and TOGO M2313 stating 50 mM at pH 7.8 in the receiving minimal medium. That last context does not define a separately prepared stock. Preserve all exact occurrence subsets. The filed #1238 grade correction applies only to the solid salt; NEW-03 separately withdraws unsupported material components from the two buffer candidates.
